entries.name: TP Enter Triggers
entries.description: Tests two enter triggers: always grows Overgrown (2 stacks, 5 turns) on its side, and with 50% chance raises its own Physical Attack.

entries.name: TP Hit Contact Rare
entries.description: Tests a contact hit trigger at 1% chance: physical hits may Shock the attacker.

entries.name: TP Hit Noncontact
entries.description: Tests a contact false hit trigger at 50% chance: any hit may lower the attacker's Special Attack.

entries.name: TP Hit When Field
entries.description: Tests the field and side condition on triggers: Chills the attacker when Soaked is on its own side, Burns it when Scorched is on the foe's side.

entries.name: TP Round End When HP
entries.description: Tests a round_end trigger gated by hp_below: heals a quarter of its HP each round while below half HP.

entries.name: TP Round End Sweep
entries.description: Tests a round_end trigger with an all_enemies target at 1% chance: may Daze every foe.

entries.name: TP Knockout When Underdog
entries.description: Tests a knockout trigger gated by underdog: a knockout while outnumbered refills its energy.

entries.name: TP Knockout Boost
entries.description: Tests a knockout trigger at the stat stage limit: a knockout raises its Speed by 3 stages.

entries.name: TP Faint Curse
entries.description: Tests a faint trigger landing on the attacker: whoever knocks it out is Burned and takes a tenth of their HP.

entries.name: TP Faint Field
entries.description: Tests a faint trigger that sets a field state at 50% chance: scorches the enemy side.

entries.name: TP Chain A
entries.description: Depth-guard case with TP Chain B: its hit trigger strikes the attacker, which would set off B's hit trigger and loop, but the depth guard stops trigger effects from firing triggers.

entries.name: TP Chain B
entries.description: Depth-guard case with TP Chain A: its hit trigger strikes the attacker, which would set off A's hit trigger and loop, but the depth guard stops trigger effects from firing triggers.

entries.name: TP Kitchen Sink
entries.description: Tests one passive using all four lists at once: an always-on effect, a trigger of every kind, and all three overworld ops.

entries.name: TP Field Encounter None
entries.description: Tests the overworld encounter_rate op at 0: no wild encounters while it leads.

entries.name: TP Field XP Encounter Max
entries.description: Tests the overworld xp_mult and encounter_rate ops at their x5 maximum.

entries.name: TP Field Bond None
entries.description: Tests the overworld bond_gain op at 0 and xp_mult at 0: no Bond or XP while it leads.

entries.name: TP Purifier
entries.description: Tests cure_status on a round_end trigger (clears its own status each round) and the status trigger (raises its own Physical Attack one stage when given a status).
